reviews.title: Great arm, full support, amazing cable management
reviews.comment: Super reliable, it is heave but sturdy, it gives you that feeling of security that your monitor won't fall off, I'm currently using a 49'' and I can rest assured that it won't go any where. On top of that the ability to hold more than one monitor is really desirable, really a space saver with a  lot of cable management included in it. Something to notice is that this arm does not includes a vesa adapter to connect with the Samsung Odyssey G9 for example, that will have to be purchased separated
reviews.author: tomas diaz

reviews.title: Does exactly what I need it to do.
reviews.comment: For the longest time I had been using the regular desk stand with my Samsung 57" Ultra-wide monitor and then I started revamping the gaming space and wanted to free up valuable desk real estate. I've previously used the Ergotron monitor arms for my monitors and they work very well, but I wasn't in the mood to spend 400+ for a monitor arm. I came across this monitor arm that got decent reviews online so I decided to give it a shot. It's perfect for my needs. It holds the 57" monitor really well. You will need to use the included VESA plate that came with the monitor to mount it correctly. The arm was very quick to build and (although not recommended) I was able to mount it without any assistance. The adjustability of the arm is decent although I don't plan on moving it around much. It has a built in cable management option which works very well at hiding the cables for a clean install. The item seems well-built and has a good weight to it to support the monitor. I would highly recommend it for anybody looking for a mount to hold a heavy duty monitor. Just make sure to follow the instructions with regards to dialing the tension. It includes the tool to do it and it's pretty straightforward to adjust.
reviews.author: Ali Khan

reviews.title: Great arm, just be sure to adjust head prior to installing monitor
reviews.comment: Works great for my 57in Samsung G9 Monitor. Installation was easy, quality feels solid, and did not put much weight strain on my desk. The one thing that could be included in the instructions is tightening/loosing the tilt head to make the mounted monitor more level. It mentions loosening/tightening the tiny screw in the back of the tilt head, but doesn't mention doing the same for the two larger black bolts near it. I was not able to get the tilt correct until adjusting those two. Recommend doing those prior to placing mount on the head, otherwise you'll either need an extra person or use some strength to get it to the right tilt while tightening the bolts again. But otherwise great product. Monitor does not "jiggle" and stays in place perfectly. Good range of motion.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: Worth the price
reviews.comment: Great monitor mount. Held a G9 Odyssey OLED with no issues.  There is no swivel support, but this is an excellent arm for the price. No sag and mounting it to the desk and arm is simple.
reviews.author: Samuel Manfre

reviews.title: Absolute Quality
reviews.comment: Super heavy duty arm would highly recommend and the finish is beautifull, will buy another in the near future. Just make sure you desk is not to wobbly or to thin to prevent any sagging, the arm along with the heavy monitor.I built a support in the wall because the arm is heavy and my monitor screen is as well.
reviews.author: Victor
